Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 37, "heading": "CHAPTER 35. DEPRESSION", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u037-b0158", "target": "После этого комплимента он принялся дёргаться таким невыносимым образом, что моя тётушка, которая сидела, глядя прямо на него, потеряла всякое терпение.", "source_sha256": "7fb13ebc8fcc985e9e3456f9ca8a2a687c22b91f0fc07ca59bf995b82b4e042f", "target_id": "ru-en85-u037-b0158", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1bcd81cab908c2fdbf26f6de6ea9de80b29cafee946b683e9101a933ce6ebaf4"}, {"source_id": "en85-u037-b0159", "target": "— Чёрт бы побрал этого человека! — строго сказала тётушка. — Что он вытворяет? Не гальванизируйтесь, сударь!", "source_sha256": "f210009f0b8531ea95956a4c676fa70daa3435d25a531b81c513afa432cdb983", "target_id": "ru-en85-u037-b0159", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "dc39bc9a3a1c062d0ea52e388a6e68b8dbca5b8356e4396f6a35c52e8cf0e794"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 35, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u037-b0160", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I ask your pardon, Miss Trotwood,’ returned Uriah; ‘I’m aware you’re nervous.’", "sha256": "4c135f39dbfd569c374bdb146a75aec888b1e9000bf36fc667a202e8b12fc6db", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[161]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0161", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Go along with you, sir!’ said my aunt, anything but appeased. ‘Don’t presume to say so! I am nothing of the sort. If you’re an eel, sir, conduct yourself like one. If you’re a man, control your limbs, sir! Good God!’ said my aunt, with great indignation, ‘I am not going to be serpentined and corkscrewed out of my senses!’", "sha256": "f78fe4fc9c0bd2450691fd76deaab752ca04804279276304df19dadea77e3f1b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[162]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0162", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Heep was rather abashed, as most people might have been, by this explosion; which derived great additional force from the indignant manner in which my aunt afterwards moved in her chair, and shook her head as if she were making snaps or bounces at him. But he said to me aside in a meek voice:", "sha256": "5516460982f3c4aaf158cd79052a43a7f430752c6ca7bffe8175821b416b3bcb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[163]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0163", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am well aware, Master Copperfield, that Miss Trotwood, though an excellent lady, has a quick temper (indeed I think I had the pleasure of knowing her, when I was a numble clerk, before you did, Master Copperfield), and it’s only natural, I am sure, that it should be made quicker by present circumstances. The wonder is, that it isn’t much worse! I only called to say that if there was anything we could do, in present circumstances, mother or self, or Wickfield and Heep,—we should be really glad. I may go so far?’ said Uriah, with a sickly smile at his partner.", "sha256": "403bc58f2015a9867f36964783e283cd10d2521533be7059dc7767b8edcdb08e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[164]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0164", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Uriah Heep,’ said Mr. Wickfield, in a monotonous forced way, ‘is active in the business, Trotwood. What he says, I quite concur in. You know I had an old interest in you. Apart from that, what Uriah says I quite concur in!’", "sha256": "735199b73cc85f84a200ac08f36a0b3beb3e217bb6b978b836a8c7ac4534e3c6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[165]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0165", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, what a reward it is,’ said Uriah, drawing up one leg, at the risk of bringing down upon himself another visitation from my aunt, ‘to be so trusted in! But I hope I am able to do something to relieve him from the fatigues of business, Master Copperfield!’", "sha256": "db223d282f42ba20e19fcebc4d72c4d436e45107edf7d5fcde46af3f8980d281", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[166]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0166", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Uriah Heep is a great relief to me,’ said Mr. Wickfield, in the same dull voice. ‘It’s a load off my mind, Trotwood, to have such a partner.’", "sha256": "b61110e6fbf3bb952ef2f0e421e102c7df8dfd277566aac226b2d6653bd36f10", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[167]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0167", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The red fox made him say all this, I knew, to exhibit him to me in the light he had indicated on the night when he poisoned my rest. I saw the same ill-favoured smile upon his face again, and saw how he watched me.", "sha256": "1b362dd96cc90ec772ba983874faff0126235b4880e74b32ccffa7118d64d659", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[168]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0168", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You are not going, papa?’ said Agnes, anxiously. ‘Will you not walk back with Trotwood and me?’", "sha256": "8bd0c90f78d232c85d3c300d3d79e947065995ebcf07945056696c1c20912c05", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[169]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0169", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He would have looked to Uriah, I believe, before replying, if that worthy had not anticipated him.", "sha256": "9b50ad3e163fd45db9b1a7615f7d4dca5299b4bd2389aca36c1619dd421e4832", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[170]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0170", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am bespoke myself,’ said Uriah, ‘on business; otherwise I should have been appy to have kept with my friends. But I leave my partner to represent the firm. Miss Agnes, ever yours! I wish you good-day, Master Copperfield, and leave my umble respects for Miss Betsey Trotwood.’", "sha256": "f8f615bb2048ce025ca34ca4591f06aebb1fdfe5d70fc8874e8ba82c5c367aec", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[171]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0171", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "With those words, he retired, kissing his great hand, and leering at us like a mask.", "sha256": "4ab6145175354651ee35f329eea41e14816fe62f56424d3e23a6d2b997858bd9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[172]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0172", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We sat there, talking about our pleasant old Canterbury days, an hour or two. Mr. Wickfield, left to Agnes, soon became more like his former self; though there was a settled depression upon him, which he never shook off. For all that, he brightened; and had an evident pleasure in hearing us recall the little incidents of our old life, many of which he remembered very well. He said it was like those times, to be alone with Agnes and me again; and he wished to Heaven they had never changed. I am sure there was an influence in the placid face of Agnes, and in the very touch of her hand upon his arm, that did wonders for him.", "sha256": "2cebab9ee720c7985bc58ae6c5a42c2edb139fa85887a79fc82b5c9e3789677a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[173]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0173", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt (who was busy nearly all this while with Peggotty, in the inner room) would not accompany us to the place where they were staying, but insisted on my going; and I went. We dined together. After dinner, Agnes sat beside him, as of old, and poured out his wine. He took what she gave him, and no more—like a child—and we all three sat together at a window as the evening gathered in. When it was almost dark, he lay down on a sofa, Agnes pillowing his head and bending over him a little while; and when she came back to the window, it was not so dark but I could see tears glittering in her eyes.", "sha256": "f53f229c9b3f3206786deaf10081d67ecc898ce1487d37e9760c45bf3e1ddf55", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[174]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0174", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I pray Heaven that I never may forget the dear girl in her love and truth, at that time of my life; for if I should, I must be drawing near the end, and then I would desire to remember her best! She filled my heart with such good resolutions, strengthened my weakness so, by her example, so directed—I know not how, she was too modest and gentle to advise me in many words—the wandering ardour and unsettled purpose within me, that all the little good I have done, and all the harm I have forborne, I solemnly believe I may refer to her.", "sha256": "7511904accd72175b72b54a65238edf0edac3ed558aa3882798b1218b266bb62", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[175]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0175", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "And how she spoke to me of Dora, sitting at the window in the dark; listened to my praises of her; praised again; and round the little fairy-figure shed some glimpses of her own pure light, that made it yet more precious and more innocent to me! Oh, Agnes, sister of my boyhood, if I had known then, what I knew long afterwards—!", "sha256": "531253c4886c6041cf4a94673b44dec51ed30acaa608bfe69c7f818b81b8d1a4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[176]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0176", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "There was a beggar in the street, when I went down; and as I turned my head towards the window, thinking of her calm seraphic eyes, he made me start by muttering, as if he were an echo of the morning: ‘Blind! Blind! Blind!’", "sha256": "90ffdef015136e3d3feee2b7adc178a232a1d3807fa4689b5b2826e1c510639b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[177]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
